title: E/10478/2018 — Kiritkumar B Patel vs. Ahmedabad-iii
text:
In The Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
West Zonal Bench At Ahmedabad
E/COD/10217/2018-SM
Appeal No.E/10478/2018-SM
Kirtikumar B Patel Appellant
Vs
C.C.E. & S.T.-Ahmedabd-iii Respondent
Represented by:
For Appellant:Shri K.C. Rathod (Consultant)
For Respondent: Shri Gobind Jha (AR)
CORAM:
HON’BLE DR. D.M. MISRA, MEMBER (JUDICIAL)
Date of Hearing/Decision: 27.04.2018
Misc. Order No. _M/__10 342 /2018
Per: D. M. Misra
Heard both the sides.
2. This application is filed seeking condonation of delay of 27 days in
filing the appeal before this forum. Ld. Consultant for the appellant
submits that the appeal could not be prepared and filed because of
sickness of Consultant.
3. In view of the reasons explained in the application, the delay is
condoned. MA (COD) is allowed.
(Dictated and pronounced in the open court)
(Dr. D.M. Misra)
Member (Judicial)
seema
